results.rationale: Consistency: black frame and white setting remain, but the printed botanical scene is substantially redrawn and brand lettering is distorted beyond perspective effects. Instruction: only a modest frontal angle changes; the broad picture face remains visible instead of the narrow edge and triangular support profile in the reference. Quality: frame edges are coherent, but plant foliage is smeared into dark clumps and small brand lettering is malformed.

Consistency: elephant pose and woodland layout remain, but tusk profiles and trunk tip are altered, and ground shadow/vegetation detail changes. Instruction: the unnatural saturated red skin remains unchanged in substance, while tusks and trunk are merely reshaped; the unreasonable animal coloring is not corrected. Quality: as a stylized painting, the elephant, tusks, wrinkles, landscape and shadows are structurally coherent and free from noticeable artifacts.
